title: 1516. Minimum Cost Assignment with Bitmask DP

Minimum Cost Assignment with Bitmask DP
70
Hard
Problem Statement:
You are given an N x N matrix 
cost
 where 
cost[i][j]
 represents the cost of assigning the i-th task to the j-th person. Each person can be assigned to at most one task, and each task must be assigned to exactly one person. Your goal is to assign all tasks to people such that the total cost is minimized. 
Input Description:
- The first line contains a single integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 20), the number of tasks and people.
- The next N lines each contain N integers, where the j-th integer in the i-th line is 
cost[i][j]
 (0 ≤ cost[i][j] ≤ 10^6). 
Output Description:
- Print a single integer: the minimum total cost to assign all tasks to people. 
Sample Input:
3
9 2 7
6 4 3
5 8 1 
Sample Output:
9 
Explanation:
Assign task 0 to person 1 (cost 2), task 1 to person 2 (cost 3), and task 2 to person 0 (cost 5). Total cost = 2 + 3 + 8 = 13.
